angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: New gadgets make life easier by helping people perform tasks quickly, such as taking clear pictures of faraway things to keep good memories.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: New gadgets make life easier by helping people perform tasks quickly, such as taking clear pictures of faraway things to keep good memories.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, new gadgets can cause problems, such as spending too much time on screens, which makes face-to-face communication difficult and can lead to loneliness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, new gadgets can cause problems, such as spending too much time on screens, which makes face-to-face communication difficult and can lead to loneliness.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses how inventions make life easier by helping people do tasks quickly, using mobile phones as an example.

angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses the negative drawback that people can become too dependent on new inventions, using the internet as an example.

angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses the potential drawback of over-reliance on new gadgets and its negative impact on health.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses the positive impact of inventions on communication, using the structure: Point (easier communication) -> Explain (talking to people far away quickly) -> Example (mobile phone) -> Effect (stay connected) -> Link (keep strong social links).
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph discusses the positive impact of inventions on communication, using the structure: Point (easier communication) -> Explain (talking to people far away quickly) -> Example (mobile phone) -> Effect (stay connected) -> Link (keep strong social links).

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses the negative impact of inventions on health, using the structure: Point (serious problems for health) -> Explain (spending too much time on screens) -> Example (eye strain/poor posture) -> Effect (physical activity decreases) -> Link (negative effects on our bodies).
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph discusses the negative impact of inventions on health, using the structure: Point (serious problems for health) -> Explain (spending too much time on screens) -> Example (eye strain/poor posture) -> Effect (physical activity decreases) -> Link (negative effects on our bodies).

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
